name: Gallywix's Head
summary: In Orgrimmar, Gallywix's Head proves that a Venture Company overseer was executed. The Shattered Hand demands the trophy as proof of the killing.

sections.title: A Grim Proof of Elimination
sections.body: Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix directed the Venture Company's work from its tower north of the Sludge Fen. When word arrived that the Venture Co. planned something on a grand scale, the Shattered Hand sent operatives to dismantle the facility. Bringing Gallywix's head to Shenthul in Orgrimmar proves the overseer was executed and secures the rogue's standing within the guild.

sections.title: The Sludge Fen Incursion
sections.body: The order to take Gallywix's head also calls for a stolen cache of Zanzil's altered mixture and the slaughter of the tower's poisoned personnel. Operatives assassinate Gallywix atop his perch and return his head to the Cleft of Shadow. The deed confirms that the Venture Company's grand scheme in the Barrens has been broken.

faq.answer: The head belongs to Grand Foreman Puzik Gallywix, a goblin supervisor overseeing Venture Company operations at the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens.

aliases: who do i give the head to
faq.answer: Shenthul wants Gallywix's Head. He is a rogue trainer and Shattered Hand operative in the Cleft of Shadow in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does the Shattered Hand want him dead?
faq.answer: Puzik Gallywix ran the Venture Company tower north of the Sludge Fen, where the Venture Co. planned something on a grand scale. He also kept the last cache of Zanzil's altered mixture in his lockbox. The Shattered Hand marked him for death to break the operation and seize the mixture.
Puzik Gallywix is at the very top of the Venture Company tower, just north of the Sludge Fen in the northern Barrens.

angles.text: As a rogue, retrieving Gallywix's Head proves your lethal skill in covert infiltration, stealth, and targeted assassination for the Shattered Hand.
As a member of the Horde, you help curb the Venture Company's exploitative industrial incursions threatening the borders of the Barrens and Durotar.
